questions.question: What should happen next with the OpenDAL question?
RFC-0025 D7 absorbs class P items whose whole subject is the kernel or a driver into BK-489. How should ID-272 be filed?

options.label: Standalone, dep by ID (Recommended)
options.description: Keep ID-272 in § 4 as its own breadth item; drop the 'class P / paused (RFC-0024)' label; state 'waits on BK-489 (D10) and BK-485' by ID. Justified because positioning and delegation outcomes are not wholly driver work. Dossier adds the branch where D10 drops the kernel: the OpenDAL adapter then targets the v1 Backend contract instead.

options.label: Absorb into BK-489
options.description: Follow RFC-0025 D7 literally: ID-272 becomes a sub-bullet '(was ID-272, absorbed here)' in BK-489, plus § Absorbed entry and a line in BK-489's dossier. Loses ID-272 as a visible breadth item; the dossier stays and is linked.
